name: pa_benchmark
description: A coding benchmark hosted by CodingNinja that evaluates models on program-writing and problem-solving tasks. Tasks are typically code-generation style problems where correctness is judged by functional tests or exact-match of outputs. Intended to measure practical coding ability and functional correctness of generated programs.
evaluation_method: pass@k (functional correctness evaluated via unit tests)
reputation: A community / platform benchmark with modest adoption primarily among CodingNinja users and some practitioners evaluating coding models.
